messages:
incident-bot: Pager: KVCache OOM on hosted-runtime-prod-us-west-3. Memory >95% on 3 pods, OOMs observed, likely runaway context / prefix amplification. Paging on-call.

alice-oncall: ack. jumping in. grabbing logs and rolling checks.

alice-oncall: quick snapshot: top consumers correlate with very long sessions (tokens ~100k-150k). sample session: s-9a1b2c3d. KV cache entries ballooning, continuous-batching queue length spiked.

bob-runtime: saw this trend at ~11:22 UTC in metrics. continuous-batching + aggressive prefetch created accumulation loop. suspects: PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS unset + batch-window growth.

carol-sre: any customer-facing 5xxs?

runtime-bot: Alert -> error-rate spike: 0.8% 5xx across hosted cluster during window. Top affected tenants: org-X, org-Y.

alice-oncall: plan: immediate mitigation = cap prefetch sessions + roll back aggressive batch size. will hotpatch PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS down to 50 (currently unlimited). dave, can you apply?

dave-ops: applying now. command: `kubectl -n infra set env deployment/prefetch-controller PREFETCH_MAX_SESSIONS=50` && `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prefetch-controller` :rocket:

runtime-bot: Deploy started by dave-ops. rollout to nodes in us-west-3.

alice-oncall: monitoring memory. initial signs of flattening on gpu-23. one OOM'd pod requeued but no new OOMs for 2m.

bob-runtime: recommend canary for batch-window change. PROPOSE: `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024` (from 2048). Canary to 10% traffic first. lowers accumulation risk.

carol-sre: canary ok. toggling canary in pool-b. `/svc toggle batch-window-canary true`

alice-oncall: canary metrics: memory down 22% on canary nodes, p50 latency +3%. acceptable. approve full rollout.

dave-ops: rolling runtime serving config: `kubectl set env deployment/runtime-serving MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=1024 --record`

runtime-bot: Batch config rollout 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% in 6 minutes. No further OOMs reported.

alice-oncall: customer-impact note: ~0.8% requests 5xx, short window ~12 minutes during spike. CS notified. creating incident ticket.

eve-cs: notified org-X and org-Y with short blurb + ETA for root-cause analysis. will share mitigation steps and temporary client recommendations (session length limits, backoff).

bob-runtime: root-cause preliminary: unbounded prefetch + long prompt sessions cause KV cache growth beyond eviction heuristics; continuous batching increases in-flight KV references -> memory amplification.

alice-oncall: follow-ups for eng-runtime: implement session-level prefetch caps, early prefix-length heuristic to disable prefetch for sessions > 20k tokens, and add stronger eviction for long-tail keys. created follow-up epic link: INC-2026-045.

carol-sre: recommend adding an alert for sustained KV growth per-session (5m trend) to detect earlier.

alice-oncall: monitors stable for 25m, closing pager. Handoff: eng-runtime owns the bugfix epic; eng-sre to add improved alerts. CS to continue customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident marked resolved by alice-oncall. Duration ~37m. Postmortem required.

alice-oncall: thanks team. logging timeline & commands used in the incident channel.

bob-runtime: notes saved. will include a perf/regression test for continuous-batching X long-prompt scenarios.

eve-cs: will follow up with customers once postmortem is out. :white_check_mark:
